name: book_flight_ok-environment
description: Runtime manifest for the book a flight and send confirmation workflow.

tools.search: Searches the flight inventory and records that matching fares have been searched.
tools.filter: Takes searched flight results, requires searched results, narrows them into a filtered fare set, and records that fares are filtered.
tools.book: Takes the filtered fare set, requires filtered fares, creates the flight booking, and records the flight as booked.
tools.email: Takes a booked flight, requires the booking, sends the customer confirmation email, and records confirmation_sent.
